title: Toward responsible face datasets: modeling the distribution of a disentangled latent space for sampling face images from demographic groups
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on mitigating demographic bias (race, gender, age) in face recognition datasets by proposing a method to generate synthetic faces.
